lines.en: I pass the ruined doorway.

lines.zh: 我的脚跟不着地，像在滑
lines.en: My heels do not touch the floor.
I circle the fort's outer wall.
My strides are long.
I cross a charred beam.
I duck through a low door.
My sword swings at my side.
I follow the smoke.

lines.zh: 我在碎石上走得没有声音
lines.en: I cross rubble without a sound.

lines.zh: 我从一堵倒下的墙后绕出
lines.en: I come around a fallen wall.

lines.zh: 我靠近了一点，又退回去
lines.en: I close in, then withdraw.
I move to your rear flank.
I stand, fire burning behind the wall.
Ash still clings to my armour.
I listen to wind through the ruins.
This was a fortress once.
The fire behind the wall breathes for me.

lines.zh: 我的手一直没有松开剑柄
lines.en: My hand has not left the hilt.
I am still; the firelight is not.
I wait for someone to come in.

lines.zh: 火光在我甲上爬了一寸。
lines.en: Firelight crawls an inch along my plate.
These ruins are mine.
You entered my fort.
I can read your movements.
You are in the open ground before me.
My armour is harder than you think.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势露了破绽
lines.en: Your gait gives you away.
I wait for you to blink first.
Behind you is a broken wall.
I have not seen a living one in a long while.
I am weighing what you are worth.
You will not cross these ruins.
A gap is knocked in my armour.
I slip half aside, not quite.
You have skill.
I fall back, then press in again.
My blade stutters.
A plate rings.
I will remember that move.
My knees buckle; I force them straight.
No blood, but pain.
I adjust my angle.
The dead do not eat.
What is that for?
That means little to me.
You had better put that away.
I lost my appetite long ago.
I only want your life.
It is covering your hand.
I want none of it at all.

lines.zh: 我闻出生人东西上的汗味。
lines.en: I smell the sweat on a living one's things.
Take it and stay away from me.
You crashed right into me.
I slide half a step aside.
Your strength is not bad.
Do not press yourself on me.
My sword nearly left my grip.
Two sets of armour clash and ring.
I pull back and reset.
That cost you something.
Your foot has pinned mine.
I set myself upright again.

lines.zh: 我坟头的草换过几轮了。
lines.en: The grass on my grave has turned over many times.
Such things stayed in the grave.
I cut off such thoughts long ago.
There is none of that in ruins.
No need to say that again.
I turn my side to you and go.
I keep these ruins.
You are asking the wrong one.
I lift my blade.
I keep walking.
Everything in these ruins is mine.
I flick it up with my blade.
This has already burned.
I look and throw it away.
It is hot, and I do not care.

lines.zh: 这儿的东西谁也别想拿回
lines.en: Nobody takes back what lies here.
I wedge it under a plate.
This will burn.

lines.zh: 烧过的东西入不了我眼。
lines.en: Burnt things do not interest me.
I crush it underfoot.
You went somewhere you should not.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛已经找到你了
lines.en: My eyes have found you.
My blade is already up.
There is no road out for you.
My fort does not welcome you.
I have stepped out from the wall.
You are at my best range.
I do not mean to leave you a chance.
My blade tip is on you.
Your blood is still moving.
I wait for the instant you turn.

lines.zh: 我起手从来不数第二下。
lines.en: I never count a second blow.
I am coming now.
Retreating will not help.
This angle will do.

lines.zh: 我的剑已经压到你影子上。
lines.en: My blade already covers your shadow.

lines.zh: 矮下身子，我贴地滑过去。
lines.en: I duck low and glide in along the ground.
One flick and I am at your flank.
Your cut found only air.
I step half off, and you miss.
I wait for you to overcommit.
The more you rush, the easier I slip.
My armour is a map of old cuts.
I have worked round behind you.
Your breathing has gone uneven.
I let you get three steps out.
There is an opening in you.
Fire burns behind the wall.
My blade follows you.
I will be waiting at the next corner.

lines.zh: 你打不到我，我打得到你
lines.en: You cannot hit me; I can hit you.
One more step forward.
You are against the broken wall.
I laugh, though you cannot see it.
You did not guard that one.
I rush in low.
Now, this very moment.
My blade cuts in.
You got clear quickly.
That one only grazed.
I add another cut.
You blocked, but not fast enough.
My armour took your blow.
Firelight runs along my blade.
You fall back behind the rubble.
That one carried weight.

lines.zh: 我的动作快过你的眼睛
lines.en: My move is faster than your eyes.
I am back in position.
There is a new gap in you.
I rush low along the ground.
I add the last cut.
My edge is turning.
These are my ruins.

lines.zh: 我从废墟的阴影里出现
lines.en: I come out of the ruins' shadow.
A shape appears in the smoke.
I take the fort's doorway.
Firelight catches my armour.

lines.zh: 我从倒塌的墙后绕出来
lines.en: I come around the broken wall.
The ash is still warm here.

lines.zh: 我的剑在手里转了一圈
lines.en: I turn my blade once in my hand.
I straighten up slowly.
These ruins have a keeper.
I heard living footsteps.
I raise my helmet.
I glide forward a stretch.
The wind clears some ash.
I take this gate.
Torch flame washes over my armour.
I am cut down off the broken wall.
Water floods my breastplate.
The blast throws me into the rubble.
An arrow finds my armour's seam.
Magic burns across the ash on me.
I have long had no need to eat.
Lightning strikes the ruin's tower.
The floor gives way; I claw at the air.
